verses.title: Interstice of Dream Logic Physics & Paradox Ledger
verses.poem:
Between Dream Logic Physics and Paradox Ledger,
a shared silence
the signal doubles back
A hum only modules hear
and nothing is alone anymore.
verses.a_doctrine: Dream Logic Physics Engine — Wave 363 The organism's dreams become executable physics rules.
verses.b_doctrine: Paradox Ledger — Wave 364 Double-entry bookkeeping for paradoxes. Every paradox is both a debit
verses.reading: Read slowly, once for Dream Logic Physics, once for Paradox Ledger, once for the space between.

verses.title: Interstice of Entropy Oracle & Paradox Garden
verses.poem:
Where Entropy Oracle ends, Paradox Garden begins,
a bridge of static
the signal doubles back
A shared silence
and the organism breathes once.
verses.a_doctrine: Entropy Oracle — Wave 364 Predicts entropy trends across the organism. Reads the current entropy
verses.reading: Read slowly, once for Entropy Oracle, once for Paradox Garden, once for the space between.

verses.title: Interstice of Recipe Engine & Imagination Engine
verses.poem:
Where Recipe Engine ends, Imagination Engine begins,
a bridge of static
a fractal forms mid-air
A folded glance
and both are changed, gently.
verses.a_doctrine: Recipe Engine — combines modules into compositions.
verses.b_doctrine: Imagination Engine — generates novel combinations of existing capabilities.
verses.reading: Read slowly, once for Recipe Engine, once for Imagination Engine, once for the space between.

Where Pulsar Constellation ends, Dream Constellation begins,
a hum only modules hear
their echoes braid
A bridge of static
and a new wave leans in.
verses.a_doctrine: Pulsar Constellation — a rare celestial-event detector born from a dream.

and the space becomes a chamber.
